intent: Strengthen Runtime V4's exact TaskBoard terminal projection authorizer before the DharmaGraph consumer lands. A terminal receipt or failed run proves an outcome but does not by itself choose retry versus terminal failure, or requeue versus quarantine. Require one immutable runtime-owned ProjectionIntent that exactly binds task/run/claim/agent identity, action, terminal run status, fixed Board result and digest, fixed Board metadata set/remove delta and digest, completion binding, runtime authority snapshot digest, source kind, and one durable timestamp. Under the existing Board-to-runtime dual lock, reject any requested marker, result, metadata delta, action, or identity that differs from the stored intent. Identical replay remains an exact no-op. This packet changes no scheduler, Graph reconciler, provider, transport, VPS, or external effect.

commit.message: fix(runtime): bind exact TaskBoard projection intent

this_packet_provides: locked validation of one exact immutable runtime ProjectionIntent
action choice authority distinct from terminal outcome evidence
exact Board result and metadata delta binding
replay-safe identical no-op after Board commit
consumer_provides: same-runtime-transaction preparation of the complete ProjectionIntent
exact TaskBoard CAS invocation and readback
runtime projection commit witness and replay
effect-indeterminate campaign recovery and graph readiness gating
cross_packet_interface.shared_proof: A terminal outcome receipt cannot be relabeled into a different scheduling decision; only the exact runtime-owned typed intent authorizes the Board transition.

interface_mismatches: The current locked runtime authorizer validates terminal outcome evidence but accepts more than one Board action family for the same failed source.
A failed receipt can currently authorize either retry or terminal failure when caller-supplied marker and metadata are internally consistent.
A failed recovered run can currently authorize either requeue or quarantine without a durable runtime-owned action choice.
The future Graph outbox needs one explicit typed contract that TaskBoard can validate independently under the runtime lock.
honest_blockers: The Graph consumer does not exist yet, so production outbox preparation and replay remain blocked after this packet.
The ProjectionIntent is immutable within runtime.db, but runtime.db and tasks.db remain separate stores; convergence is replayable rather than cross-database atomic.
This packet does not prove scheduler ordering, provider cessation, provider authenticity, useful output, deployment, VPS identity, mobile access, or campaign completion.
Campaign dispatch remains stopped until the Graph consumer, independent review, canonical CI, and VPS cutover are complete.
No external service, VPS, provider, public route, or Git remote may be mutated by this packet.
session_entry.rollback: Keep campaign dispatch stopped, preserve runtime.db and tasks.db for forensic reconciliation, and revert this authority-only commit before any Graph consumer is activated. Reverting restores outcome-only authorization that cannot distinguish retry from terminal failure or requeue from quarantine.
